```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r initiate}
rm(list = ls())
# 0a.Declare root directory, folder location and load essential stuff
project.folder = paste0(print(here::here()), '/')
source(paste0(project.folder, 'create_folder_structure.R'))
source(paste0(functions.folder, 'script_initiate.R'))
```

# 1. Load case-crossover dataframe

```{r load}
case_crossover_df <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df.RDS"))
setDT(case_crossover_df)
case_crossover_df[, cal_month := lubridate::month(date)]
```

# 2. Filter to spring and fall migration windows; drop strata without both case and control

```{r filter}
spring_dt <- case_crossover_df[cal_month %in% c(3, 4, 5)]
fall_dt   <- case_crossover_df[cal_month %in% c(9, 10, 11)]

spring_keep <- spring_dt[, .(n_case = sum(outbreak_binary == 1),
                              n_ctrl = sum(outbreak_binary == 0)),
                          by = stratum_id][n_case > 0 & n_ctrl > 0, stratum_id]
spring_dt   <- spring_dt[stratum_id %in% spring_keep]

fall_keep <- fall_dt[, .(n_case = sum(outbreak_binary == 1),
                          n_ctrl = sum(outbreak_binary == 0)),
                      by = stratum_id][n_case > 0 & n_ctrl > 0, stratum_id]
fall_dt   <- fall_dt[stratum_id %in% fall_keep]

cat("Spring (Mar–May): ", sum(spring_dt$outbreak_binary), " cases, ",
    sum(spring_dt$outbreak_binary == 0), " controls, ",
    uniqueN(spring_dt$stratum_id), " strata\n", sep = "")
cat("Fall   (Sep–Nov): ", sum(fall_dt$outbreak_binary),   " cases, ",
    sum(fall_dt$outbreak_binary == 0),   " controls, ",
    uniqueN(fall_dt$stratum_id),   " strata\n", sep = "")
```

# 3. Spring model (primary 6-variable spec, lag 0–28 d)

```{r spring}
cb_runoff <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_soil_moisture <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_temperature <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_precipitation <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_wind_speed <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_anseriformes <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(spring_dt[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:28), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, 28), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "strata", breaks = c(7, 14, 21))
)

model_spring <- clogit(
  outbreak_binary ~
    cb_runoff + cb_soil_moisture + cb_temperature +
    cb_precipitation + cb_wind_speed + cb_anseriformes +
    strata(stratum_id),
  method = "efron", data = spring_dt
)
saveRDS(model_spring, paste0(models_folder, "casecrossover_model_spring.RDS"))

cp_runoff_sp <- crosspred(cb_runoff,        model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_soil_sp   <- crosspred(cb_soil_moisture, model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_temp_sp   <- crosspred(cb_temperature,   model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_precip_sp <- crosspred(cb_precipitation, model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_wind_sp   <- crosspred(cb_wind_speed,    model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)
cp_bird_sp   <- crosspred(cb_anseriformes,  model_spring, cen = 0, at = 0.5, cumul = TRUE)

n_sp <- ncol(cp_runoff_sp$cumRRfit)
or_runoff_sp <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_runoff_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp], cp_runoff_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp], cp_runoff_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
or_soil_sp   <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_soil_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp],   cp_soil_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp],   cp_soil_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
or_temp_sp   <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_temp_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp],   cp_temp_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp],   cp_temp_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
or_precip_sp <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_precip_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp], cp_precip_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp], cp_precip_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
or_wind_sp   <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_wind_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp],   cp_wind_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp],   cp_wind_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
or_bird_sp   <- sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", cp_bird_sp$cumRRfit["0.5", n_sp],   cp_bird_sp$cumRRlow["0.5", n_sp],   cp_bird_sp$cumRRhigh["0.5", n_sp])
```

# 6. Side-by-side comparison table

```{r table}
comparison <- data.table(
  Predictor          = c("Runoff", "Soil Moisture", "Temperature",
                         "Precipitation", "Wind Speed", "Anseriformes"),
  `Pooled (primary)` = c(or_runoff_pl, or_soil_pl, or_temp_pl, or_precip_pl, or_wind_pl, or_bird_pl),
  `Spring (Mar–May)` = c(or_runoff_sp, or_soil_sp, or_temp_sp, or_precip_sp, or_wind_sp, or_bird_sp),
  `Fall (Sep–Nov)`   = c(or_runoff_fa, or_soil_fa, or_temp_fa, or_precip_fa, or_wind_fa, or_bird_fa)
)
print(comparison)

ft <- comparison %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Cumulative ORs (per 0.5 SD, lag 0-28 d) for the pooled primary case-crossover model and migration-season stratified sensitivities. Spring = March-May; Fall = September-November.",
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc, target = paste0(tables_sensitivity_folder, "Table_Migration_Season_Sensitivity.docx"))
```

# 7. Weekly-window cumulative ORs by season (0–7 d and 8–14 d)

```{r weekly-windows}
lag_seq        <- 0:28
lag_basis_met  <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis, c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_runoff, "arglag")))
lag_basis_bird <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis, c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_anseriformes, "arglag")))

contrast_0_7      <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_met[lag_seq  >= 0 & lag_seq <=  7, , drop = FALSE])
contrast_8_14     <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_met[lag_seq  >= 8 & lag_seq <= 14, , drop = FALSE])
contrast_bird_0_7  <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_bird[lag_seq >= 0 & lag_seq <=  7, , drop = FALSE])
contrast_bird_8_14 <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis_bird[lag_seq >= 8 & lag_seq <= 14, , drop = FALSE])

# 7a.Helper-free per-season per-predictor extraction
window_or <- function(model, term_prefix, contrast) {
  idx <- grep(paste0("^", term_prefix, "v"), names(coef(model)))
  b   <- coef(model)[idx]
  V   <- vcov(model)[idx, idx]
  lo  <- sum(contrast * b)
  se  <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% V %*% contrast))
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", exp(lo), exp(lo - 1.96 * se), exp(lo + 1.96 * se))
}

weekly_tbl <- data.table(
  Predictor = c("Runoff", "Soil Moisture", "Temperature",
                "Precipitation", "Wind Speed", "Anseriformes"),
  `Pooled 0–7 d` = c(window_or(model_pooled, "cb_runoff",        contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_pooled, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_pooled, "cb_temperature",   contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_pooled, "cb_precipitation", contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_pooled, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_pooled, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_0_7)),
  `Pooled 8–14 d` = c(window_or(model_pooled, "cb_runoff",        contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_pooled, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_pooled, "cb_temperature",   contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_pooled, "cb_precipitation", contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_pooled, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_pooled, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_8_14)),
  `Spring 0–7 d` = c(window_or(model_spring, "cb_runoff",        contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_spring, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_spring, "cb_temperature",   contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_spring, "cb_precipitation", contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_spring, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_0_7),
                     window_or(model_spring, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_0_7)),
  `Spring 8–14 d` = c(window_or(model_spring, "cb_runoff",        contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_spring, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_spring, "cb_temperature",   contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_spring, "cb_precipitation", contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_spring, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_8_14),
                      window_or(model_spring, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_8_14)),
  `Fall 0–7 d` = c(window_or(model_fall, "cb_runoff",        contrast_0_7),
                   window_or(model_fall, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_0_7),
                   window_or(model_fall, "cb_temperature",   contrast_0_7),
                   window_or(model_fall, "cb_precipitation", contrast_0_7),
                   window_or(model_fall, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_0_7),
                   window_or(model_fall, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_0_7)),
  `Fall 8–14 d` = c(window_or(model_fall, "cb_runoff",        contrast_8_14),
                    window_or(model_fall, "cb_soil_moisture", contrast_8_14),
                    window_or(model_fall, "cb_temperature",   contrast_8_14),
                    window_or(model_fall, "cb_precipitation", contrast_8_14),
                    window_or(model_fall, "cb_wind_speed",    contrast_8_14),
                    window_or(model_fall, "cb_anseriformes",  contrast_bird_8_14))
)
print(weekly_tbl)

ft_weekly <- weekly_tbl %>%
  flextable() %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  autofit() %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  theme_booktabs()

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_weekly) %>%
  body_add_par(
    "Weekly-window cumulative ORs (per 0.5 SD) under the primary 6-variable case-crossover model, pooled and stratified by migration season.",
    style = "Normal"
  )
print(doc, target = paste0(tables_sensitivity_folder, "Table_Migration_Season_Weekly.docx"))
```

# 8. Save results bundle

```{r save}
saveRDS(list(
  comparison   = comparison,
  weekly_tbl   = weekly_tbl,
  model_pooled = model_pooled,
  model_spring = model_spring,
  model_fall   = model_fall,
  spring_n     = c(cases = sum(spring_dt$outbreak_binary), strata = uniqueN(spring_dt$stratum_id)),
  fall_n       = c(cases = sum(fall_dt$outbreak_binary),   strata = uniqueN(fall_dt$stratum_id))
), paste0(objects_folder, "migration_season_sensitivity.RDS"))
```
